title: Warm Spanish Potatoes Skillet
description: A flavorful and spicy Spanish dish featuring double-fried potatoes, perfect for a brunch mood, with a bitter and juicy twist, made in a traditional iron teppan
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan over medium-high heat
Peel and cut the potatoes into 1-inch cubes
Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in the teppan and fry the potatoes until golden brown
Remove the potatoes from the teppan and set aside
Add the remaining olive oil to the teppan and fry the potatoes again until crispy
Add the smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the teppan and stir for 1 minute
Add the cherry tomatoes to the teppan and cook for 2 minutes
Add the fried potatoes back to the teppan and stir to combine with the cherry tomatoes and spices
Squeeze the lemon juice and sherry vinegar over the potatoes and stir to combine
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot
